thread:
anya: Quick ask — we need a field-ready one-pager + launch post + webinar hook aimed at regulated customers (FinServ + Healthcare). Core focus: SLAs across Hosted / Dedicated / Private, security controls, deployment tradeoffs, and a simple inbound routing/qualification playbook for Sales. Goal: draft by Tue EOD, final by Thurs.

mike: Copy + visual layout — I can do the one-pager headline + 300-word body. Do we want explicit SLA numbers or phrasing like 'industry-grade'?

anya: explicit numbers please. Ops has target SLAs so use those. Short bullets only.

jordan: From ops: suggested SLA guidance — Hosted: 99.9% uptime, P95 latency target 120ms for 1k tokens; Dedicated: 99.95% uptime, P95 80ms; Private: SLA negotiable (customer-controlled infra), recommend template language. I'll confirm exact wording.

sarah: I'll draft benchmarking narrative to justify the numbers — p95 and cost-per-1k tokens for each deployment mode. Need perf data from eng-runtime. Lucas, can you pull the 2k token p95 runs?

lucas: On it. Quick note — our Dedicated benchmarks assume 8xA100 batch sizes; Hosted numbers use mixed-quantized variants. I'll attach a short note to the doc.

anya: Great. For messaging: front-line bullets for sales: 1) predictable cost & SLA, 2) security controls + KMS/HSM, 3) same API across modes, 4) simple migration path. Keep it one column.

mike: For the launch post / webinar hook, propose: "How to run compliant, low-latency LLMs in regulated environments" — 30-min webinar with demo of Dedicated + Private failover to Hosted. Call to action: request a private deploy checklist + SLA one-pager.

sarah: Webinar narrative outline: 1) Regulated risks + why serving matters, 2) SLA & infra options, 3) Live demo: canary + fallback in action, 4) Benchmarks + Q&A. Will draft slides.

jordan: Inbound routing — Sales wants auto-qualification to send Private/Dedicated interest to AE queue and Hosted interest to PS. Proposed simple HubSpot workflow: tag = "deploy_mode_interest" values: hosted, dedicated, private. If private OR high-compliance keywords => route to enterprise queue.

mike: Can we include a tiny snippet for the sales playbook in the one-pager? Example qualification questions (2): "Is data required to stay on-prem?" and "Annual token volume estimate?"

anya: Yes — include 2x qualification Qs + next-step links (book a compliance call / request checklist).

lucas: Here's a minimal inbound routing snippet (pseudo-HubSpot):

```json
{
  "trigger": "form_submit",
  "fields": {
    "deploy_preference": "private|dedicated|hosted",
    "compliance_keywords": "pci,hipaa,gdpr"
  },
  "actions": [
    {"if": "compliance_keywords", "route": "enterprise_ae_queue"},
    {"else_if": "deploy_preference=='private'", "route": "enterprise_ae_queue"},
    {"else": "route_to_ps_queue"}
  ]
}
```

sarah: Nice. For the one-pager visuals: 1x SLA bar chart, 1x security stack icon row (KMS, HSM, audit logs), 1x deployment-mode decision flow. I'll sketch.

anya: Timing check: Mike + Sarah draft by Tue EOD. Lucas + Jordan to confirm numbers & routing by Tue noon. I'll assemble Wed morning and circulate for feedback.

ops-bot: reminder: please attach the Dedicated perf CSV at /shared/marketing/assets/dedicated_perf_q4.csv — mentioned by lucas.

mike: I'll also write a short benchmark callout for the post (50-75 words) emphasizing p95 wins and cost delta.

jordan: Webinar scheduling — prefer Tue next week 10am PT or Wed 1pm PT. Which works for ops?

lucas: Wed 1pm PT works for eng folks.

anya: Lock Wed 1pm PT then. I'll send invites and a draft outline. Anything else?

mike: Add a single-slide compliance checklist as downloadable asset.

sarah: I'll include the checklist in the slide deck and one-pager link.

anya: Awesome — thanks team. I'll create the doc folder and link all assets once drafts are in. :rocket:
